change: Safe-Guard recall minus external dataset recall, within each classifier
boundary_reason: Midsemester used yes >=0.08 and no <0.08. To express the final handout's closed no inequality, no <=0.0799 introduces an explicit 0.0001 undecided gap below the unchanged yes cutoff. This clarification was fixed before new transformer results and is not a statistical significance test.
normalization_selection: One fixed blind normalizer accepted on Safe-Guard validation with TF-IDF, then used unchanged for all classifiers. Require mean recall across three obfuscations to improve and normalized-view FPR not to exceed clean validation FPR by more than 0.01.
gandalf_mixed_control: All 1000 presumed Gandalf positives plus all 1409 retained held-out Safe-Guard benign rows. Supplemental only. Not verified style matching; no original Gandalf negatives exist.
zero_shot: Separate Week 10 L1 class-description embedding comparison. Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B instead of lecture 8B due local GPU capacity; fixed descriptions and cosine margin threshold0, no labeled calibration. Not part of trained-model primary table.
